description: Test suite for parsing CLI JSON and JSONL outputs from various AI assistant sessions, validating extraction of session metadata, responses, and usage statistics.

methods.name: parseCliJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string or array of JSON objects to extract response text, session ID, and usage info.

methods.name: parseCliJsonl
methods.description: Parses newline-delimited JSON (JSONL) strings, capable of handling multiple JSON objects per line, extracting response, session ID, and usage info.
